name: tmcra-memory
description: Explicit long-term Agent memory for MCP hosts
long_description: Recall project evidence, preserve user and Agent roles, commit real turns, and reconcile durable asynchronous writes through the TMCRA Memory API.

tools.description: Commit the prepared user turn and exact assistant answer

tools.name: tmcra_wait_job
tools.description: Wait for a write job to reach a terminal state
